plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM (limma)
plan.analytical_narrative: The core delivered only a gene-level TPM table from Salmon (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 lesional, 6 control skin), no raw counts and no quantification directories. Count-based tools (DESeq2/edgeR) assume integer counts with negative-binomial variance and are invalid on TPM; per the grounded procedure (R-0004), the correct path is limma on log2(TPM+1) values with eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE). The plan runs: (1) sample-structure QC (PCA/MDS, sample distances, detected-gene counts on log2(TPM+1)) to confirm the two groups separate and to catch any outlier or batch structure before modeling; (2) low-abundance filtering (TPM>=1 in at least 6 samples, the smaller group size) followed by log2(TPM+1) transform with no count-style between-sample normalization (TPM already carries within-sample length/depth scaling); (3) limma differential expression with an explicit reference level (Control) and named contrast (Lesional - Control), BH-adjusted topTable results; (4) over-representation analysis (clusterProfiler, tested-gene universe) of the significant gene sets against MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome pathway collections, since limma on TPM gives no DESeq2-style Wald/shrunken-LFC statistic to rank a preranked GSEA on and the knowledge-check requires ORA in this situation; (5) a reproducibility-complete report with method, versions, thresholds, gene counts tested/significant, and enrichment details. All steps state explicitly that this is a TPM-only analysis: no length-scaled-count reimport via tximport is possible since quantification directories were not delivered, and this caveat is carried into the report rather than glossed over.

TPM >= 1 in at least 6 samples (smallest group)
limma (lmFit + eBayes, trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) on log2(TPM+1)
fgsea preranked GSEA on limma moderated t-statistic, MSigDB Hallmark + Reactome
Sample structure QC on log abundance values: MDS or PCA, sample distances, detected genes
Low abundance filter on TPM, FPKM, or log expression values
limma linear model on log-scale expression values
fgsea preranked GSEA on the moderated t-statistic with MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome
Sample structure QC on log abundance values: MDS or PCA, sample distances, detected genes
Low abundance filter on TPM, FPKM, or log expression values
limma linear model on log-scale expression values
Over-representation analysis with an explicit universe (tested genes) on the significant gene list, MSigDB Hallmark and Reactome
